front: How do you convert Avgas litres to mass?
back:
Mass (kg) = litres × **0.72**.
Example: 102 L = 73.44 kg ≈ **74 kg**.

front: How are distance, time, fuel and endurance calculated?
back:
Distance = GS × time.
Time = distance ÷ GS; fuel = flow × time.
Endurance = usable fuel ÷ flow.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Distance = GS × time</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Fuel = flow × time</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Endurance = fuel ÷ flow</text></svg>

front: How do you calculate moment?
back:
**Moment = mass × arm**.
Use consistent units (e.g. kg·m or lb·in).

front: How do you calculate the loaded aircraft CG?
back: **CG = Σ moment ÷ Σ mass**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Σ moments</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ Σ mass</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>CG</text></svg>

front: When is an arm negative?
back:
When the mass is **forward of the datum**.
Oil ahead of datum can therefore have negative moment.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Datum</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>← negative arm</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>load</text></svg>

front: What does positive or negative moment signify?
back: Positive = clockwise; negative = anticlockwise (about the datum).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>+ clockwise</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>− anticlockwise</text></svg>

front: What balance limits must CG satisfy?
back: CG must remain between the **forward and aft limits** in all flight phases.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Forward limit</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>CG OK</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Aft limit</text></svg>

front: Why must CG remain within limits in every phase?
back: For stability and controllability.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>All phases</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Stability</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Control</text></svg>

front: Where do you obtain masses and arms for a particular aircraft?
back: From that aircraft’s **mass & balance section** of its POH/AFM.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>This aircraft</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>POH / AFM</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Mass & balance</text></svg>

front: How is empty mass and CG initially determined?
back: By **weighing** the aircraft.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Aircraft</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>→ scales</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>empty mass / CG</text></svg>

front: What must be done to determine basic empty mass?
back: Drain all **usable fuel**; unusable fuel remains included.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Drain usable fuel</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Keep unusable fuel</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Determine basic empty mass</text></svg>

front: What is the exam definition of basic empty mass?
back: Aeroplane + fixed ballast + unusable fuel + **undrainable oil** + coolant + hydraulic fluid.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Aeroplane + fixed ballast</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Unusable fuel + undrainable oil</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Coolant + hydraulic fluid</text></svg>

front: How does basic empty mass relate to standard empty mass?
back: Basic empty mass = standard empty mass + **optional equipment**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Standard empty</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+ optional equipment</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Basic empty</text></svg>

front: What does standard empty mass include?
back: Airframe, engine, fixed equipment, unusable fuel, full oil and (where applicable) hydraulic fluid.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Airframe + engine</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Unusable fuel</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Full oil / fluids</text></svg>

front: Which empty-mass log entry should you use?
back: The **latest/most recent** entry (PFP-006).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Empty-mass log</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Use latest entry</text></svg>

front: How often should aircraft be reweighed, and what about modifications?
back: About every **6 years**; modifications require an updated W&B sheet.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Reweigh ≈ 6 years</text><rect x='65' y='65' width='190' height='80' rx='12' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.18' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='88' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Modification</text><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Update W&B</text></svg>

front: What is useful load?
back: Maximum take-off mass − basic empty mass.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>MTOM</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>− basic empty mass</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Useful load</text></svg>

front: What is payload?
back: Passengers + baggage + cargo (not crew or fuel).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Passengers</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Baggage + cargo</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>= payload</text></svg>

front: What is zero-fuel mass?
back: Everything except **usable fuel**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Aircraft + load</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>− usable fuel</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Zero-fuel mass</text></svg>

front: What does ramp mass include?
back: Start, taxi and run-up fuel; it is also called maximum ramp mass (MRM).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Ramp mass</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>includes taxi/run-up fuel</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Take-off mass</text></svg>

front: How does maximum ramp mass differ from MTOM?
back:
Ramp mass includes taxi fuel; MTOM is the take-off limit.
Example: 1145 − 1140 = 5 kg excess → burn ≈ **7 L** Avgas before take-off.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Ramp mass 1145</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>MTOM 1140</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>5 kg ≈ 7 L</text></svg>

front: Which mass limits should be checked before computing CG?
back: MTOM, MLM, zero-fuel mass and baggage limits; stop if any is exceeded.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Mass limits first</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Then calculate CG</text></svg>

front: How is landing mass found from take-off mass?
back: Landing mass = take-off mass − trip fuel burnt.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Take-off mass</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>− trip fuel</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Landing mass</text></svg>

front: How do you handle oil not included in empty mass?
back: Add it as a variable load; if ahead of datum, its moment is negative.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Oil ahead of datum</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>negative moment</text></svg>

front: Why must baggage be secured?
back: To prevent CG shifts, uncontrollable attitudes, structural damage and injury.

front: Why is lateral balance often ignored in light aeroplanes?
back:
It is generally ignored; alternate fuel tanks.
Lateral balance matters for helicopters.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Light aircraft</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Alternate tanks</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Helicopters: important</text></svg>

front: What are the effects of a forward CG?
back: More stability; higher stall speed; more elevator force and fuel consumption.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Forward CG</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>↑ stability / stall speed</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>↑ fuel burn</text></svg>

front: What are the effects of an aft CG?
back: Less longitudinal stability; lower stall speed and fuel burn, but poorer stall/spin recovery.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Aft CG</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>↓ stability / stall speed</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Recovery risk</text></svg>

front: What is the risk of a very forward CG?
back: Nose-heavy aircraft may be unable to flare or rotate.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Forward CG</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>nose-heavy</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>flare / rotation difficult</text></svg>

front: How do you move an out-of-limits CG back into limits?
back: Move baggage, swap passengers or reduce fuel/load; recheck mass and CG.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Move load / swap seats</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Reduce load</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Recalculate CG</text></svg>

front: How do you estimate CG shift when moving a mass?
back: ΔCG = mass moved × distance moved ÷ total mass.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>moved mass × distance</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ total mass</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>ΔCG</text></svg>

front: How does burning fuel affect CG?
back:
Subtract burnt fuel mass and its tank moment, then recalculate CG.
Fuel behind CG burnt → CG forward; fuel ahead burnt → CG aft.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Subtract fuel mass</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Subtract tank moment</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Recompute CG</text></svg>

front: How is the seesaw balance principle expressed?
back: Large mass × short arm can balance small mass × long arm (equal moments).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Large mass × short arm</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>=</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Small mass × long arm</text></svg>

front: How should a mass/moment table be completed?
back: List load, mass, arm and mass×arm moment; sum mass and moments, then divide.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Mass × arm = moment</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Σmass & Σmoment</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>CG = ΣM / Σm</text></svg>

front: When using a moment/100 or moment/1000 table, what is the trap?
back: Rescale the moment correctly; match units (kg·m, lb·in, cm, in).

back: CG = **44 in**, but 2532 lb exceeds the **2300 lb** maximum: do not depart.

back: Plot mass against moment; point **inside polygon = OK**. Check take-off and landing points and any limit lines.

back: Each item’s mass is read against its arm line to obtain moment/1000; sum moments and masses, then plot.
