front: What are the components of required VFR fuel?
back: Taxi + trip + contingency + alternate + final reserve + additional fuel.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Taxi</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Trip + contingency</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Alternate + final reserve</text></svg>

front: What does trip fuel include, and exclude?
back:
Includes climb, cruise and descent.
Excludes taxi, alternate and reserves.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Climb + cruise + descent</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>≠ taxi / alternate / reserve</text></svg>

front: What contingency is typically used in these questions?
back: Typically **5% of trip fuel**, or the stated amount (e.g. 30%).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Contingency</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>usually 5% trip</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Use stated %</text></svg>

front: What VFR final reserve is used for day and night?
back: Day: **30 min**; night: **45 min** at cruise power.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Day 30 min</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Night 45 min</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>cruise power</text></svg>

front: How much fuel for 3 h at 11.9 USG/h, plus 30% and 2 USG taxi?
back: Trip = 35.7 USG; with 30% = 46.4; + taxi = **48.4 USG**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>3 × 11.9 = 35.7</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+30% = 46.4</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+2 taxi = 48.4 USG</text></svg>

front: What is total trip fuel when climb/cruise/descent use 12 + 25 + 7 L?
back: **44 L** trip fuel. Taxi, alternate and reserve are additional.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>12 + 25 + 7</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>= 44 L trip</text></svg>

front: How much endurance remains in the Q57 fuel example?
back: 120 lb − 40 alternate − 30 reserve = 50 lb; 3.2 lb/min → **15.6 min**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Usable 50 lb</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ 3.2 lb/min</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>15.6 min</text></svg>

front: Q100: 180 kg includes 30% reserve; 100 kg remains halfway. How much at destination?
back: Reserve = 54 kg; trip = 126 kg. Half-trip used = 80 kg → destination fuel **20 kg**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>180: 54 reserve / 126 trip</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>80 used halfway</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>20 kg at destination</text></svg>

front: Q101: 60 USG used in 2 h 20 min. What was flow?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>60 USG</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ 2.333 h</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>25.7 USG/h</text></svg>

front: Q104: trip 70 USG, 5% contingency, 40 used at halfway; 20 reserve. Enough?
back: Trip incl. contingency = 73.5; total used = 80; 15 remain < 20 reserve: **insufficient**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>70 + 5% = 73.5</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>80 used → 15 remain</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>< 20 reserve</text></svg>

front: Q105: 90 USG start, 30 used at halfway, 20 reserve. Extra at landing?
back: Trip = 60; landing fuel = 30; after 20 reserve, **10 USG extra**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>30 × 2 = 60 trip</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>90 − 60 = 30</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>−20 reserve = 10 extra</text></svg>

front: How do you calculate endurance from usable fuel?
back: Subtract unusable fuel and required reserve first; divide remaining fuel by consumption rate.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Start fuel</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>− unusable − reserve</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ flow = endurance</text></svg>

front: Endurance example: 24.2 USG total, 3.2 unusable; 136 NM at 86 kt, 10.5 USG/h. Fuel left?
back: Usable 21.0; time 136/86 = 1.58 h; used 16.6 → **4.4 USG left**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>21.0 USG usable</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>1.58 h × 10.5 = 16.6</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>4.4 USG left</text></svg>

front: If flow is constant, how can trip fuel be estimated from halfway fuel used?
back: Double fuel used in the first half to estimate total trip fuel.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Halfway use</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>× 2</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Total trip fuel</text></svg>

front: What is fuel remaining at destination?
back: Start fuel − fuel used on trip; compare with alternate and required reserve.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Start fuel</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>− trip used</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Compare reserve / alternate</text></svg>

front: How do you calculate headwind and crosswind components?
back: For angle α from runway/track: HW = V cos α; XW = V sin α.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Wind V</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>HW = V cos α</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>XW = V sin α</text></svg>

front: Wind 250°/10 kt on runway 22 (220°): headwind component?
back: Angle 30°; 10 cos 30° ≈ **9 kt headwind**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Runway 220°</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Wind 250°; Δ30°</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>≈9 kt headwind</text></svg>

front: Wind 240°/12 kt on runway 36: headwind/tailwind and crosswind?
back: Wind is from left rear at 60°: **6 kt tailwind**, **10.4 kt crosswind from left**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Runway 360°</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Wind 240°; Δ120°</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>6 kt tail / 10.4 left</text></svg>

front: What component shortcuts apply at 30°, 45° and 60°?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>30°: 0.87 / 0.5</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>45°: 0.7 / 0.7</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>60°: 0.5 / 0.87</text></svg>

front: What does a reported wind direction mean?
back: The direction the wind is **from**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Wind direction</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>FROM</text></svg>

front: Maximum wind for a 12 kt crosswind limit at 30°?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>XW limit 12 kt</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ sin 30°</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>24 kt max wind</text></svg>

front: How is wind-correction angle calculated?
back: WCA = asin[wind speed × sin(wind angle) ÷ TAS].
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Wind × sin(angle)</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>÷ TAS</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>asin = WCA</text></svg>

front: How do you estimate groundspeed with a headwind or tailwind?
back: GS ≈ TAS − headwind component; add the tailwind component.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>TAS</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>− headwind / + tailwind</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>GS</text></svg>

front: A 240 NM out-and-back flight: TAS 105 kt, wind 15 kt. Approximate total time?
back: Out GS 120: 2 h; back GS 90: 2 h 40; total **4 h 40 min (4.67 h)**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>240/120 = 2 h</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>240/90 = 2 h 40</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Total 4.67 h</text></svg>

front: For a 120 NM out-and-back, TAS 90 kt and 20 kt wind, how much fuel at 6 USG/h?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>GS 110 / 70</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Time ≈ 2.8 h</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>×6 = 16.8 USG</text></svg>

front: A 320 NM leg: wind 270/20, TAS 113, desired track 330°. What are the planning results?
back: GS **102 kt**; WCA **9° left**, heading **321°**; time 188 min; fuel at 42 L/h = **131.6 L**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>GS 102 kt</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>WCA 9° left → WH321°</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>188 min; 131.6 L</text></svg>

front: How does TAS change with altitude at constant IAS?
back: TAS ≈ IAS × (1 + **2% per 1000 ft**); it increases as you climb.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>IAS held constant</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+2% / 1000 ft</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>TAS rises</text></svg>

front: For maximum range, how does a strong wind affect the best TAS?
back: Strong tailwind: slightly lower TAS; headwind: slightly higher TAS.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Tailwind → lower TAS</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Headwind → higher TAS</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>for max range</text></svg>

front: What is the climb-gradient rule of thumb?
back: Climb % = ROC ÷ TAS (both per minute in compatible units); angle ≈ % × **0.57°**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>ROC ÷ TAS = %</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>% × 0.57</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>≈ climb angle</text></svg>

front: At 100 kt, what ROC is a 5% climb? How much height in 6 min?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>100 kt × 5%</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>500 ft/min</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>×6 = 3000 ft ≈ 926 m</text></svg>

front: If you climb 3000 ft in 6 min, covering 5 NM, with a tailwind, how far would the ground distance be?
back: Climb time remains **6 min** and ROC is unchanged; tailwind increases distance to **6 NM**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Same 6 min / ROC</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Tailwind</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>5 NM → 6 NM</text></svg>

front: How much ROC is needed to climb 8000 ft in 7 min?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>8000 ft</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>÷ 7 min</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>≈1142 ft/min</text></svg>

front: What ROC rule of thumb is used for rate-one turns?
back:
Rate-1 bank angle ≈ TAS/10 + 7.
At 110 kt: **18°**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>110/10 + 7</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>≈18° bank</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Rate 1</text></svg>

front: Define take-off ground roll.
back: Distance travelled along the ground during the take-off run, up to lift-off.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Ground roll</text><rect x='125' y='45' width='70' height='112' rx='4' fill='#59636e'/><path d='M160 50 V67 M160 82 V99 M160 114 V131 M160 145 V154' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='4'/><text x='35' y='67' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>runway to lift-off</text></svg>

front: What is take-off distance (TOD)?
back: Ground roll + distance to clear a **50 ft (15 m)** obstacle.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Ground roll</text><rect x='125' y='45' width='70' height='112' rx='4' fill='#59636e'/><path d='M160 50 V67 M160 82 V99 M160 114 V131 M160 145 V154' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='4'/><text x='35' y='67' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>+ 50 ft / 15 m</text><text x='35' y='92' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>TOD</text></svg>

front: What conditions generally increase take-off distance?
back: High mass/temp/elevation, tailwind, soft/wet/long grass, uphill slope, poor configuration, low tyre pressure or low engine power.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Hot / high / heavy</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Tailwind / uphill / soft</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Distance ↑</text></svg>

front: What effect does increased air density have on take-off distance?
back: It does **not** lengthen take-off; denser air improves performance.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Higher density</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>more performance</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>not longer TOD</text></svg>

front: What is the effect of higher temperature on a piston engine?
back: Higher temperature → lower air density → **less engine power**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Temperature ↑</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Density ↓</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Piston power ↓</text></svg>

front: What is the effect of a headwind on take-off?
back: Shortens take-off distance and gives a steeper climb-out path.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Headwind</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>TOD ↓</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Climb path steeper</text></svg>

front: What is the effect of tailwind on take-off?
back: It **lengthens** take-off distance.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Tailwind</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>TOD ↑</text></svg>

front: In a tailwind shear on climb-out, what happens as tailwind increases?
back: Airspeed and rate of climb decrease.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Tailwind increases</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Airspeed ↓</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>ROC ↓</text></svg>

front: How do take-off flaps affect ground roll and climb?
back: More take-off flap: shorter ground roll and lower lift-off speed, but poorer climb angle/rate.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>More flap</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Ground roll ↓</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Climb performance ↓</text></svg>

front: In PFP-007, what does shorter ground roll with shallower climb imply?
back: A higher flap setting.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Shorter roll</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Shallower climb</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Higher flap setting</text></svg>

front: How do you read PFP-009 take-off distance nomogram?
back:
Left→right: OAT → pressure altitude → mass → wind → distance.
Solid wind guide = headwind; dashed = tailwind.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>OAT → PA</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>→ mass → wind</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>→ distance</text></svg>

front: How do you interpolate a take-off table and apply corrections?
back: Interpolate PA/temp first, then apply wind/temp corrections and surface footnotes in the chart’s stated order.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Table / interpolate</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Temp + wind</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Surface correction</text></svg>

front: C172 example: 2300 lb, 15 kt headwind, 2500 ft, 75°F, grass. TOD?
back: Wind interpolation: (1485+1100)/2 =1293 ft; temp +10% =1422; grass +7% = **1522 ft**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>1293 ×1.10 =1422</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>×1.07</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>1522 ft</text></svg>

front: C172 example: 2000 lb, same conditions, hard runway. TOD?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>862.5 ft</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>×1.10</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>≈949 ft</text></svg>

front: What is the grass-footnote trap in the C172 example?
back: Grass +7% applies to **TOD**; even if asked for ground roll, add 7% of TOD.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Grass correction</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+7% of TOD</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>even for ground-roll query</text></svg>

front: What unit may a lesson stall-speed table use?
back: **MPH**, not knots. 50 kt ≈ **57.5 mph**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>50 kt</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>≈57.5 mph</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Check chart units</text></svg>

front: How are PA-28 PFP-009 style graphs read?
back: OAT → PA line → mass → wind → distance; follow the guide paths in sequence.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>OAT</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>PA → mass</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>wind → distance</text></svg>

front: Name the landing phases in order.
back: Approach → round-out → hold-off → touchdown → roll-out → braking.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Approach → round-out</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Hold-off → touchdown</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Roll-out → braking</text></svg>

front: Define landing distance and landing ground roll.
back:
Landing distance: from 50 ft obstacle to stop.
Ground roll: touchdown to stop.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>50 ft obstacle</text><rect x='125' y='45' width='70' height='112' rx='4' fill='#59636e'/><path d='M160 50 V67 M160 82 V99 M160 114 V131 M160 145 V154' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='4'/><text x='35' y='67' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>→ touchdown → stop</text><text x='35' y='92' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Landing distance includes flare</text></svg>

front: What is the effect of strong headwind on landing distance?
back: It shortens landing distance.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Headwind</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>landing distance ↓</text></svg>

front: How does a 10 kt headwind correction affect landing distance under the rule of thumb?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>5 kt → −10%</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>10 kt → −20%</text></svg>

front: What dry-grass landing correction is given?
back: Add **20%** to landing distance; it also applies to the roll.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Dry grass</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+20%</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>distance / roll</text></svg>

front: Can an alternate be accepted if LDA is 500 m but required distance is 550 m?
back: **No.** Required landing distance must not exceed LDA.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>LDA 500 m</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Required 550 m</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>No</text></svg>

front: What must landing distance required be compared with?
back: The available **LDA**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Landing distance required</text><rect x='125' y='45' width='70' height='112' rx='4' fill='#59636e'/><path d='M160 50 V67 M160 82 V99 M160 114 V131 M160 145 V154' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='4'/><text x='35' y='67' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>≤ LDA</text></svg>

front: Identify the ASI colour-arc speeds from bottom/top landmarks.
back: Bottom white = VS0; bottom green = VS1; top white = VFE; top green/bottom yellow = VNO; red line = VNE.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>White: VS0 → VFE</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Green: VS1 → VNO</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Red line: VNE</text></svg>

front: What factors increase stall speed?
back: Higher mass, bank/load factor, forward CG, flaps up and increased g-load.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Mass ↑</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Bank / g ↑</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Forward CG; flaps up</text></svg>

front: What is stall-speed multiplier at 60° bank?
back: √(1/cos 60°) ≈ **1.41** times wings-level stall speed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>60° bank</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Load factor 2</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>VS × 1.41</text></svg>

front: What does Vx mean?
back: Steepest climb: reach a given height in minimum **distance**; used for obstacles.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Vx</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>minimum distance</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>steep climb</text></svg>

front: What does Vy mean?
back: Best rate of climb: reach altitude in minimum **time**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Vy</text><circle cx='160' cy='112' r='8' fill='#17324d'/><path d='M160 112 L160 48' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 112' stroke='#4f9d69' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M160 112 L252 48' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='3' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/><path d='M160 48 L154 60 L166 60 Z' fill='#2f80a8'/><path d='M252 112 L240 106 L240 118 Z' fill='#4f9d69'/><text x='160' y='75' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>maximum ROC</text><text x='85' y='165' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>minimum time</text></svg>

front: How do Vx and Vy compare?
back: Vx is normally lower than Vy; Vx maximizes excess thrust, Vy maximizes excess power.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Vx < Vy</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>Vx: excess thrust</text><text x='80' y='78' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#c84c4c'>Vy: excess power</text></svg>

front: Define service ceiling and absolute ceiling.
back:
Service ceiling: ROC **100 ft/min**.
Absolute ceiling: ROC **0**; Vx and Vy merge.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Service: 100 ft/min</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Absolute: 0 ft/min</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Vx = Vy</text></svg>

front: What causes ground effect and what is its practical effect?
back: Within about **½ wingspan**, induced drag decreases; aircraft floats and is harder to slow in the flare.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Near ground (~½ span)</text><rect x='125' y='45' width='70' height='112' rx='4' fill='#59636e'/><path d='M160 50 V67 M160 82 V99 M160 114 V131 M160 145 V154' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='4'/><text x='35' y='67' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Induced drag ↓</text><text x='35' y='92' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Float in flare</text></svg>

front: Which aircraft is more affected by ground effect?
back: A **low-wing** aircraft (more than a high-wing aircraft).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Low wing</text><path d='M55 150 L265 150' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='5'/><path d='M160 112 L135 150 L185 150 Z' fill='#e59a36' stroke='#9a5d15' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M78 104 L242 104' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M78 104 L78 85 M242 104 L242 85' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><text x='160' y='63' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17324d'>greater ground effect</text></svg>

front: How does total drag vary with speed?
back: Induced drag falls with speed; parasite drag rises with speed squared. Minimum total drag is at (L/D)max.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Induced drag ↓</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Parasite drag ∝ V²</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Minimum: (L/D)max</text></svg>

front: What are best endurance and best range on a power-required curve?
back:
Minimum power = best endurance.
Tangent from origin = best range / (L/D)max.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Minimum power</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>best endurance</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Origin tangent = best range</text></svg>

front: What is the reversed-command region?
back: At speeds below minimum power speed, slowing down requires **more** power.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Slow flight</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>power required ↑</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>reversed command</text></svg>

front: Where are excess power and excess thrust greatest?
back: Excess power at **Vy**; excess thrust at **Vx**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Excess power max: Vy</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Excess thrust max: Vx</text></svg>

front: What happens to performance curves when aircraft mass increases?
back: Curves shift up and right; a lighter glider has lower best-glide speed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Mass ↑</text><path d='M58 156 V53 M58 156 H267' stroke='#34495e' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M70 145 C115 143 122 90 164 83 S221 102 253 55' fill='none' stroke='#c84c4c' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M70 130 C130 110 190 96 253 84' fill='none' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='160' cy='92' r='5' fill='#e59a36'/><text x='160' y='174' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>curves up + right</text><text x='160' y='189' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='11' fill='#17212b'>Glider mass ↓ → glide speed ↓</text></svg>

front: At what altitude-duration condition is oxygen required by this exam reference?
back: If above **10,000 ft for more than 30 minutes**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>>10,000 ft</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>>30 minutes</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Oxygen</text></svg>

front: Which charts may be used for cruise/range/endurance planning?
back: Best-economy cruise; best-power and best-economy range; endurance; climb/descent fuel-time-distance; RPM/engine performance.

front: How is PFP-023 climb time/fuel/distance obtained?
back: Read cumulative values at top and start altitudes; **subtract start from top**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Read top value</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>− start value</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Climb requirement</text></svg>

front: What are the PFP-023 climb-distance answers?
back: 3000 ft to FL75: **7 NM**; FL65 to FL95: **6 NM**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>3000 → FL75: 7 NM</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>FL65 → FL95: 6 NM</text></svg>

front: What is PFP-011 rate-of-climb chart reading order?
back: OAT → up to PA line → horizontally to weight/mass diagonal → down to ROC.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>OAT → PA</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>→ mass diagonal</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>↓ ROC</text></svg>

front: How is PFP-012 cruise table used at FL60?
back:
Use pressure altitude (**6000 ft**); QNH is irrelevant for FL.
At ISA−20, 70%: **110 kt, 23.9 L/h**.

front: PFP-012: PA 2000 ft, OAT 31°C, 2400 rpm—fuel flow?
back:
ISA at 2000 ft = 11°C; OAT is ISA+20.
Fuel flow = **19.5 L/h**.

back: ISA temperature at altitude = 15 − 2 × PA(thousands of ft); deviation = OAT − ISA temp.

front: What range does PFP-013 give at 22°C, PA 2000, 55%?
back:

Odd thousands +500: **FL035, 055, 075, 095…**
Lowest above 3000 ft/FL050 is FL055.
