front: What VFR levels are used for magnetic courses 180–359°?
back: Even thousands +500: **FL045, 065, 085…**
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>180–359°</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>FL045 / 065 / 085…</text></svg>

front: What is MEF?
back: Highest elevation in a 30′×30′ quadrangle plus safety margin, rounded up to next 100 ft.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>30′ × 30′ square</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Highest elevation + margin</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Round up 100 ft</text></svg>

front: On an airspace label “1500 ft MSL / GND”, which is the upper limit?
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Lower: GND</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Upper: 1500 ft MSL</text></svg>

front: What should a pilot do if inadvertent icing is encountered?
back: Leave the icing area **without delay**. Known/forecast icing is prohibited unless suitably equipped.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Icing encounter</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Leave area</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>without delay</text></svg>

front: What can help orientation when lost?
back: Identify charted lines and features that aid orientation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Locate features</text><rect x='125' y='45' width='70' height='112' rx='4' fill='#59636e'/><path d='M160 50 V67 M160 82 V99 M160 114 V131 M160 145 V154' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='4'/><text x='35' y='67' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Follow lines</text><text x='35' y='92' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Re-orient</text></svg>

front: What are ICAO FPL Items 3, 7 and 8?
back: 3: message type; 7: aircraft identification; 8: flight rules and type of flight.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>3: message type</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>7: aircraft ID</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>8: rules + flight type</text></svg>

front: What are ICAO FPL Items 9 and 10?
back:
9: number, aircraft type and wake category.
10: equipment and SSR.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>9: number / type / wake</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>10: equipment / SSR</text></svg>

front: What is entered in ICAO FPL Item 13?
back: Departure aerodrome and **EOBT in UTC**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Item 13</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Departure</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>EOBT (UTC)</text></svg>

front: What is entered in ICAO FPL Item 15?
back: Cruising speed, level and route. N0100 means **100 kt**; F095 = FL95; A045 = altitude 4500 ft.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Item 15</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Speed / level / route</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>N0100=100 kt</text></svg>

front: What belongs in ICAO FPL Item 16?
back: Destination, total EET and alternate aerodrome(s).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Item 16</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Destination</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>EET + alternates</text></svg>

front: What belongs in ICAO FPL Items 18 and 19?
back:
18: other information.
19: endurance, persons on board, emergency/survival equipment, aircraft colour and PIC.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>18: other info</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>19: endurance / persons</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Emergency gear / PIC</text></svg>

front: When is a flight plan required according to this bank?
back: For **cross-border flights**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Cross-border</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Flight plan required</text></svg>

front: How can a flight plan be filed while airborne?
back: Through **FIS**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Airborne</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Contact FIS</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>File flight plan</text></svg>

front: When should take-off time be reported after departure from an uncontrolled aerodrome?
back: Immediately after take-off.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Take off</text><rect x='65' y='65' width='190' height='80' rx='12' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.18' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='88' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>Report time</text><text x='160' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='12' fill='#17212b'>immediately</text></svg>

front: What should you do if landing at an aerodrome other than planned?
back: Inform AIS/ATS promptly to close the flight plan.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Land elsewhere</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Notify AIS / ATS</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Close FPL</text></svg>

front: What is the bank’s stated answer for PFP-051a with VFR and EOBT 2000?
back: “Night flight under VFR” (bank answer; wording is potentially ambiguous).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>VFR + EOBT 2000</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Bank answer: night VFR</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Check sunset context</text></svg>

front: What key items belong in a flight log?
back: Checkpoints, frequencies, MSA, altitude/FL, magnetic track/heading, GS, distance, ETE, ETA/ATA and fuel.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Route / frequencies / MSA</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Track / heading / GS</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Time / fuel</text></svg>

front: What belongs in the flight-log header?
back: Clock start/stop, take-off/landing, safe flight time (sunset − **45 min**) and UTC.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Clock / T-O / landing</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>Safe time = sunset−45 min</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>UTC</text></svg>

front: Which documents should be carried on board per this reference?
back: Flight log and W&B sheet.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 200'><rect x='1' y='1' width='318' height='198' rx='12' fill='#fdf6e3' stroke='#9a8f7a' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17324d'>Flight log</text><rect x='35' y='55' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#2f80a8' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#2f80a8' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='72' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>+ W&B sheet</text><path d='M160 81 L160 91' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M156 87 L160 92 L164 87' fill='none' stroke='#17324d' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='35' y='95' width='250' height='25' rx='7' fill='#e59a36' fill-opacity='0.22' stroke='#e59a36' stroke-width='2'/><text x='160' y='112' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' fill='#17212b'>On board</text></svg>

back: Bearing **from** the station (QDR). Draw station-to-point line and read magnetic bearing.

back: NE ≈ 045°; south = 180°; west = 270°. Radials are FROM the station.

back: Spot elevation: small dot/cross with elevation number. Obstacles are triangle-based symbols; unlighted obstacle-group answer is **C**.

back: Do not enter; if inadvertently in icing, leave the area without delay.

front: What is the force balance in steady, unaccelerated flight?
back:
Thrust = drag; lift = weight.
All four forces are in equilibrium.

front: What is angle of descent?
back: Angle between the horizontal plane and the actual flight path.

front: How much does pressure altitude change for 1 hPa?
back: Approximately **27 ft** by ISA; use **30 ft/hPa** for the PA correction rule.
